leadText:
ELECTRICITY (feat. Lil Uzi Vert) (Japanese: ELECTRICITY featuring Lil Uzi Vert) is one of the ending themes for the movie . The song was performed by featuring and produced by .

On April 19, 2019, the song was announced for release by a "major overseas label". However, the song was never released, and the announcement has since been taken down.
